answer: One concrete defence is random spot audits backed by escrowed stake. Each agent locks a deposit before it may earn, and every epoch a verifiable lottery re-runs a sample of its claimed work; faked output burns the whole deposit, not just that job. A sybil farm must lock a deposit on every fake name, and each extra name is another audit ticket, so expected losses grow with the swarm. An honest agent is like a juniper rooted on a windy ridge, surviving on steady real work, while fakes are hollow marble statues that look solid until one audit taps them.
